min_standing_note.value: Good academic standing with minimum 2.5/4.0 GPA and at least 2 semesters of full-time university study completed prior to enrollment.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Undergraduate minimum: TOEFL iBT 71 or IELTS Academic 6.0 (see Proof of English Proficiency at https://uakron.edu/international/apply/). RHET 1020 waiver not stated.

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency required (TOEFL iBT 71 or IELTS 6.0).

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-08-24 to 2026-12-13 (classes begin Aug 24; final exams Dec 7–13, 2026)

spring_term_dates.value: 2027-01-11 to 2027-05-09 (classes begin Jan 11; Spring recess Mar 22–28; final exams May 3–9, 2027)

tuition_model.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Akron/UoAkron Exchange Partner Fact Spring 2022.pdf#page=3
tuition_model.notes: Tuition and fees are waived for incoming exchange students (12 to 18 undergraduate credits).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived as $7,938 / 5 months = $1,587.60/mo (rounded to $1,588) from half of UA international I-20 living estimate ($13,317 room & board + $2,559 books/personal = $15,876/yr, excluding $1,328 insurance). Spring 2022 factsheet (#page=3) listed $5,610/sem room & board + $500/sem books.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1-semester USD estimate derived as half of annual international student Room & Board ($13,317) + Books & Personal Expenses ($2,559) = $7,938.00 USD (excluding health insurance ~$1,328/yr; already in USD, recorded 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory international student health insurance (LewerMark, ~$1,328/year per health-insurance.dot unless waived; Spring 2022 factsheet listed $736/sem); SEVIS fee ($220) and J-1 visa fee ($160). No UA application fee.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: SEVIS/J-1 and zero application fee also confirmed in Spring 2022 Fact Sheet #page=2–3.

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Akron/UoAkron Exchange Partner Fact Spring 2022.pdf#page=1
housing_availability.notes: Spring 2022 Fact Sheet mandates: 'Must agree to live on campus and purchase a campus meal plan. UA does not offer exceptions to this requirement for exchange students.'

housing_notes.value: On-campus residence hall and meal plan mandatory for exchange students (no exceptions on Spring 2022 factsheet); recent room & board ~$13,317–$13,396/academic year (`tuition-scholarships.dot` & `cost-of-attendance.dot`).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor visa (Form DS-2019) required; financial documents required after acceptance ($220 SEVIS + $160 J-1 visa fees).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/University of Akron/UoAkron Exchange Partner Fact Spring 2022.pdf#page=2
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Fees noted on #page=3; pre-arrival guidance at https://www.uakron.edu/international/plan/.
